label: GO step when the agent chooses a1 (sparse subset)
explanation: Fires only at the GO step, and almost only when the policy picks a1 (model_act==1 covers 99% of activations and activation mass; it never fires at D1/D2 or on a2 choices). It is a sparse subset, though: only about 18% of a1-GO steps are active, so precision is low. Firing is more likely with a very confident a1 logit (choice>8: rate 24%), in the middle of the episode (trials 20-80; near zero before trial 10 and after trial 85), with high value, and when S1 is the good state. The largest activations come after an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward 0 carries 60% of mass) and often on a switch from a2 back to a1. Adding these conditions (e.g. choice>8 and ep_trial 20-80, F1 0.44) raises precision only a little, so I recorded the simple predicate. No observed variable I tried explains which a1-GO steps fire. The unit is a1-choice-specific, uses only the agent own choice, and needs no future variables.
